book.name: LUKE
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Luke wana Leleli

content: Seitani Yeisu I Palawakik
Yeisu i sikalem wewel Yolidani Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i kalaopopwi, inoke Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i nul i na uleya labi kekevana elana,
ge lan poti Seitani Yeisu i papalawakik. Lan bolo ona o elal Yeisu nige bugul etega i aan, he lan mowamowasena elana abwe i galebu nabi.
Inoke Seitani Yeisu i labose ge i baek elana i ba, “Ebo tunahot owa Yehoba Natuna, u ba pat ya elana ni tabwa aanan.”
Yeisu Seitani anana i lahe i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena i ba, ‘Nige tage gamagal aanan awawana ni an ge yawalina ni gan.’”
Inoke Seitani Yeisu i nul hi na hi ha oya mihahaina elana ge etimwawa abalogugui gegewena panayawiya i pankite.

Inoke i baek elana i ba, “Gasisi gegewena na pewa eliyam ge abalogugui bolo ya ginebi ge gogomwauina nu logugui-agil. Kaiwena iyaka Yehoba i pem eliyau, ge ebo nuwau, bosowaiu ya te na pek gamagal etega elana.
He ebo nu kululu eliyau, bugul bolo ya gegewena owa kaiwem.”
Yeisu Seitani anana i lahe i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena i ba, ‘Nu kululu Yehoba wam Yabowaine elana, iya maisena ya te nu tapwalolo elana.’”
Yaka Seitani Yeisu i nul hi na Yelusalema ge i patalmilil Limi Bwabwalena pwatanaa hot. Inoke i baek elana i ba, “Ebo tunahot owa Yehoba Natuna, u supeni lowa te.
Kaiwena Buki Bwabwalena i ba:

content.text: Yehoba ni ba wana aneloseyau elal nihi matahikagiwa bubun
inoke nige aem etega nu tutupaan pat elana.”

content: Inoke Yeisu Seitani anana i lahe i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena i ba, ‘Bahi Yehoba wam Yabowaine nu lalabose.’”
Seitani lawakik bolo o i ginol Yeisu elana i pwamowasi, inoke i eguluwan ge i matamatan wana sauga etega al.
Nasaleta Gamagaliliyau Nige Yeisu Hi Yayaliyaya-an
Yeisu alona Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana gasisi i sikal i na Galili, ge wasana i lelu labi o gegewena elana.
I na wali limi tapwalolowa i panpankiti, inoke gamagalau gegewel hi tobalan.
Inoke Yeisu i na Nasaleta, awan toto eliyana ge i bwataa, yaka lan Sabwata eliyana i na i tuk limi tapwalolowa i ola sauga gegewena i giginol. I talmilil Buki Bwabwalena ni vasili,
inoke palopita Aiseya wana buki hi pek eliyana. Buki o i pwela ge ana leleli i pwawa toto i ba i ola hiwe:

content.text: inoke i hileyau wasa waiwaisana na papaatena-an togulagula elal.
I patunau ge na ba bolo yowayowanil elal sokal nihi pwawa,
ge na ba tomatakai elal mataliya nihi panana.
I patunau bolo ali hehegan hi apapanak-an ali pulowan na abubun,
ge na baek gamagalau elal na ba, “Sauga iyaka i vin ge Babala wana gamagalau ni pwamwalil.”

content: Inoke Yeisu buki i bili ge i pek pasikal buki ana tomatahikan elana, yaka i misiyo ge ni panpankiti. Gamagalau gegewel limi tapwalolo gamwanaa mataliya hi lihikan elana.
Inoke i baek elal i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba toto abwe sauga ya ku hago, he lan ebe iyaka i tabwa tunahot.”
Gamagalau gegewel Yeisu hi ba tobalan, ge nuwaliya hi ahe wana baaba waiwaisal kaiweliya. Inoke hi ba, “He iya Yosepa natuna age?”

Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Ya atena nasi wami baaba etega nuku baunanim eliyau nuku ba, ‘Doketa, totom u sawaliwa.’ Ge nasi nuku ba, ‘Bugul bolo u ginolil Kapeniyama elana ge wasana ha hago, he nu ginol al te totom wam panuwa elana e.’”
Yaka i ba al i ba, “Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, nige palopita etega wana panuwa gamagaliliyau hi yayaliyaya-an.

Na baewa eliyamiu, tunahot Ilaitiya wana sauga elana abuabulau hi gewi hi miminaa Isileli gamwanaa. He baliman eton ge awalehina nige kehe i lalau, yaka galebu bwabwatana i masal panuwa o ana labi gegewena elana.
Yaa Yehoba nige Ilaitiya i papatuna i nana abuabulau bolo o etega i lalabe, i patuna i noek ya te abuabul etega nige Isileli yovana i oola, iya i miminaa awan Selepat panuwa Saidoni ana labiya.
He i ola al palopita Ilaisa wana sauga elana, tolepelo hi gewi hi miminaa Isileli gamwanaa, yaa Ilaisa nige etega i pwapwamolu, Naman labi Siliya gamagalina ya te i pwamolu.”
Gamagalau gegewel limi tapwalolo gamwanaa, sauga baaba o hi hago inoke hi huga nabi.
Yaka hi lut ge Yeisu hi momol tagilan panuwa tolinaa, ge hi pwatanik oya toto panuwa hi ginola, lamwanaa. Wali nuwatu tage nihi pwabun yohek lebwalebwala,
yaa i nosolaa boda gamwaliyaa ge i egon.
Yeisu Yayaluwa Bibikena I Patuna Owaowani
Inoke Yeisu i nok i na Kapeniyama Galili awanina bwabwatana, ge lan Sabwata elana i na limi tapwalolowa ge i panpankiti gamagalau elal.
Gegewel nuwaliya hi ahe wana panpankiti kaiwena, kaiwena i baaba alona ge wana gasisi.
Tau etega iyoho to limi tapwalolo gamwanaa, yayaluwa bibikena i holaviya elana. Inoke yayaluwa bibikena tau i pabaaba ge i yoga anana i bwata i ba,
“Ei! Yeisu gagama Nasaleta, ga i ola ge u nem eliyama? Age nuwam nu apapanak-agima? Ya atenawa ya, owa Yehoba wana Gamagal Bwabwalena.”
Yeisu i ba lalaan i ba, “U mikekei! U tagil elana!” Yaka yayaluwa bibikena tau o i tagapasoguwa bilibiliya gamagalau gegewel mataliyaa, ge i ulutagil nige tau tuwana i aapanak.
Gamagalau gegewel nuwaliya hi ahe, inoke hi nelnel avaliyau elal hi ba, “Hauna kaba baaba e? Tau ya alona wana gasisi i baaba yayaluwa bibikel elal inoke hi ulutagil.”
Yaka Yeisu wasana i lelu labi o gegewena elal.
Yeisu Gamagalau Hi Gewi I Pwamolol
Yeisu limi tapwalolo i eguluwan, i nok i na Saimon wana limiya. Saimon yawana nevenak i kasiyebwa, tuwana i waiwai nabi, yaka hi awanun Yeisu elana ge ni labe.
Inoke i na i talmilil labenaa ge anana i gasisi i ba kasiyebwa ni egon. Yaka tuwana waiwaina i mowasi, inoke sauga o i lut ge aanan i ginol i pek Yeisu ge alonau elal.
Sabwelu lobelobekina elana, gamagalau avaliyau bolo ali kasiyebwa tomaha ge tomaha, gegewel hi ahel ge hi pwatanik Yeisu elana. Nimana i teliya maisena ge maisena tuwaliyaa inoke gegewel i pwamolol.
I ola al yayaluwa bibikel hi tagilem gamagalau hi gewi elal ge hi yoga hi ba, “Owa Yehoba Natuna.” Yaa Yeisu i ba lopwalil ge nige i tatalamwagil nihi baaba, kaiwena hi atena te iya Mesaiya.
Yeisu I Tagil I Na I Papaatena Panuwa Enuna Al elal

Mweluluga kekeisi, Yeisu panuwa o i eguluwan i na labi etega elana toto nige gamagalau hi miminaa. Gamagalau hi loyaloya Yeisu kaiwena, ge sauga hi pwawa, inoke hi labose tage nihi lopwali ge bahi ni eegon.
Yaa i baek elal i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui wasana waiwaisana na papaatena-an ga panuwa enuna al elal, kaiwena i patunau ya nem ge tuwalali o na ginol.”
Inoke i na Yudiya wali labi gegewena ge i papaatena wali limi tapwalolo elal.
